celestialAlignment.description: Celestial alignment uses the game calendar, frozen at battle setup. Days 1-2: Solar, Solari +1 Attack and Defense. Day 3: Solar Eclipse, Lunari +2 Attack and Defense. Days 4-5: Lunar, Lunari +1 Attack and Defense. Day 6: Lunar Eclipse, Solari +2 Attack and Defense. Day 7: Convergence, both +1 Defense. Only the bearer benefits. This repeating seven-day cycle is project game fiction, not astronomy.
